domestic_evidence: Company website (https://www.thewaymembranes.com/, About Us / Clients sections) states: 'Theway Membranes has the fortune of being the first commercial hollow fiber ultrafiltration membrane manufacturer in India' and lists client names under 'Government of India Users' (BARC, DAE, UCIL, BHEL, CSIR-CFTRI, L&T, IOCL, ONGC, DRDO, TNPL, VIZAG-STEEL, CMWSSB, IIT Madras etc.) and private users (Hyundai, Renault, Ford, Toyota, Apollo Hospitals, ITC, Tata, Reliance, Adani). No GST turnover figure, no GeM/CPPP tender award, no contract document and no annual-report domestic/export split was found in the sources read; the client list is a self-declaration and is therefore 'заявлено, не подтверждено'.
